transactions.desc: The Twins designated Jackson for assignment Thursday, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.
Knack was optioned to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Thursday, Bill Plunkett of The Orange County Register reports.
Hernandez had his contract selected by the Dodgers on Thursday, Bill Plunkett of The Orange County Register reports.
The Mariners optioned Emerson to Triple-A Tacoma on Thursday, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.
The Dodgers signed Tromp to a minor-league deal Thursday, and he's been sent to Triple-A Oklahoma City, Alex Freedman of the Oklahoma City Comets reports.
The Royals designated Morgan for assignment Thursday.
The Dodgers released Robinson on Thursday.
The Mets released Ibanez on Thursday, Francys Romero of BeisbolFR.com reports.
The Royals released Strahm on Saturday.
The Rangers outrighted Bride to Triple-A Round Rock on Thursday, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports.
The Phillies added Misner to their active roster for Thursday's Field of Dreams game against the Twins.
The Giants claimed Whitcomb off waivers from the Astros on Thursday and optioned him to Triple-A Sacramento, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
The Rays designated Martin for assignment Thursday.
The Rays optioned Williams to Triple-A Durham on Thursday.
The Rays optioned Grove to Triple-A Durham on Thursday.
The Rays recalled Scholtens from Triple-A Durham on Thursday.
The Twins activated Buxton (hip) from the 10-day injured list Thursday.
Richardson cleared waivers Thursday and elected free agency, Jack Stern of BrewerFanatic.com reports.
The Tigers recalled Cruz from Triple-A Toledo on Thursday.
The Blue Jays recalled Estrada from Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday.

Godbout (hand) has gone 0-for-9 with three strikeouts over his first two games at Double-A Portland since being assigned to the affiliate Tuesday after being reinstated from High-A Greenville's 60-day injured list.
The Pirates optioned Sisk to Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Pirates recalled Mattson from Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Pirates recalled Brannigan from Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Red Sox recalled Weissert from Triple-A Worcester on Thursday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
Mateo signed a major-league contract with the Rays on Wednesday, Francys Romero of BeisbolFR.com reports.
Double-A Frisco reinstated Walcott (concussion) from the 7-day injured list Wednesday, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports.
The Dodgers recalled Knack from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday.
The Dodgers optioned Halvorsen to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday.
Curtis (side) was reinstated from Triple-A Indianapolis' 7-day injured list Wednesday, Dominic Campbell of SI.com reports.
